body.title: Bound worker launch by remaining parent time and cleanup reserve
body.summary: Update src/installer/dev-delivery.ts ownedScope and src/installer/dev-worker.ts to use manager/worker roles and canonical inherited profile. Capture monotonic parent expiry at admission and pass the LLD local-only deadline option. Immediately after runtime verification, before scope.start, cap selected/explicit worker allowance by parent remaining minus reserve; fail before spawn when exhausted. Preserve existing cancel frames, DevWorkerLaunch JSON and finalization proof. Verify private toolchain env in src/installer/dev-toolchain.ts without unrelated refactoring. Explicitly include scripts/test-harness/process.mjs in this task: capture one monotonic soft/hard cleanup deadline at the first drain of each retained scope and reuse only its remaining allowance across nested/repeated/final drains. Independently reobserve actual closure on every call; never cache a successful proof or alter ownership/disposal/journal/lease semantics. Extend the existing parent reserve fixture for repeated-drain exhaustion and run surrounding scripts/__tests__/test-harness.test.ts and scripts/__tests__/test-harness-coordinator.test.ts checks.
acceptanceChecks: Barrier-controlled runtime setup consumes parent allowance; child clock is computed after setup and never resets parent time.
No positive remaining allowance yields source-build-failed before spawn; short explicit budgetMs remains a cap.
Worker/manager use selected role values and manager120s reserve contains worker30s drain/final evidence; early cancellation remains immediate.
Actual result, worker lease closure and parent command disposal remain required; wire/controller/receipt schemas unchanged; missing proof stays preparation-uncertain.

Each retained processScope has one cumulative cleanupMs ceiling across nested launch/build and final owner drains, under both profiles. Repeated uncertain drains cannot schedule a new allowance; every call independently checks current actual closure and errors. Numeric normal defaults, cooperative cancellation, ownership/disposal journals and uncertainty/lease retention remain unchanged; surrounding coordinator/process regressions pass.
